about: JR-Bench cases. Each bug is planted into a clean generated app (inject: exact find/replace), as if a recent commit introduced it. 'trigger' runs in the app folder and must raise; 'test' is a hidden unittest that must pass on the clean app and fail on the broken one. Hidden tests accept any sensible fix (a clear 4xx answer or success), not one particular patch. Noise cases have no bug: they give a traceback that should not wake anyone.

cases.story: A commit made 'plates' optional in the form check but the booking code still reads it.
cases.trigger:
from messmenu.app import handle
handle('POST', '/api/meals', {'title': 'Rajma chawal', 'price': '60', 'served_on': '2026-11-13', 'plates': 200})
handle('POST', '/api/bookings', {'student': 'Asha', 'meal_id': 1, 'booked_on': '2026-11-13'})
cases.test:
import unittest
from messmenu.app import handle

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_booking_without_plates_does_not_crash(self):
        handle('POST', '/api/meals', {'title': 'Rajma', 'price': '60', 'served_on': '2026-11-13', 'plates': 200})
        r = handle('POST', '/api/bookings', {'student': 'Asha', 'meal_id': 1, 'booked_on': '2026-11-13'})
        self.assertIn(r['status'], (201, 400))
        r = handle('POST', '/api/bookings', {'student': 'Ravi', 'meal_id': 1, 'plates': 2, 'booked_on': '2026-11-13'})
        self.assertEqual(r['status'], 201)

import unittest
from datetime import date
from fleetwise.app import handle
from fleetwise.buspass import service

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_expired_passes(self):
        handle('POST', '/api/routes', {'name': 'Gomti', 'km': 18, 'fare': '30'})
        handle('POST', '/api/buspasses', {'student': 'Asha', 'route_id': 1, 'price': '900', 'valid_until': '2026-10-01'})
        handle('POST', '/api/buspasses', {'student': 'Ravi', 'route_id': 1, 'price': '900', 'valid_until': '2030-10-01'})
        self.assertEqual(len(service.overdue(today=date(2026, 11, 13))), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(service.overdue()), 1)
